answer.reason: The verses tell several deeds of Eleazar beyond the summary: the censers, Aaron's garments and the division of the land.

clauses.english: took the brasen censers of those burnt, to be plates covering the altar
clauses.quote: Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers

clauses.english: was clothed with Aaron's garments when Aaron died on mount Hor
clauses.quote: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son

clauses.english: with Joshua divided the land among the tribes by lot at Shiloh
clauses.quote: divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD
